title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (sac-TMT, MK-2870) Maintenance Treatment With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Newly Diagnosed Advanced non-HRD positive Ovarian Cancer Following First-line Platinum-based Chemotherapy (TroFuse-021/ENGOT-ov85/GOG-3102)
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (sac-TMT, MK-2870) Maintenance Treatment With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Newly Diagnosed Advanced non-HRD positive Ovarian Cancer Following First-line Platinum-based Chemotherapy (TroFuse-021/ENGOTov85/GOG-3102)
summary: Main objective: To compare sac-TMT maintenance treatment with or without bevacizumab to SoC, with respect to PFS per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by BICR

interventions.name: Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.
MVASI 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has diagnosis of FIGO 2014 Stage III or Stage IV, histologically confirmed epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube carcinoma with one of the following histologies: high-grade serous, high-grade endometrioid, clear cell carcinoma, or malignant mixed Müllerian tumour with a high-grade serous component.  Tumors reported as Grade 2 may be enrolled only if predominately (>50%) Grade 3 features are present.
2. Has completed primary debulking surgery or interval debulking surgery.
3. Has completed first-line (1L) platinum-based chemotherapy, with a response of stable disease, partial response, complete response, or no evidence of disease per protocol
4. Has provided tumor tissue that is not previously irradiated.
5. Has well-controlled human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) on antiretroviral therapy if diagnosed with HIV
6. Has undetectable hepatitis B virus (HBV) viral load and received HBV antiviral therapy if hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive.
7. Has undetectable hepatitis C virus (HCV) viral load if has a history of HCV infection.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has nonepithelial cancers, low-grade serous tumors, low-grade endometrioid tumors, borderline tumors mucinous, seromucinous that is predominantly mucinous, malignant Brenner's tumor, and undifferentiated carcinoma
2. Has a history of (noninfectious) pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease (ILD), which required steroids, has current pneumonitis/ILD, or has suspected ILD, or pneumonitis that cannot be ruled out by standard diagnostic assessments at Screening
3. Received prior systemic anticancer therapy, with the exception of the first-line platinum-based chemotherapy required by the inclusion criteria
4. Had a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days of randomization.
5. Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or required active treatment within the past 3 years.
6. Has a homologous recombination deficiency (HRD)-positive, unknown, or inconclusive status as determined by the central laboratory
7. Active or ongoing stomatitis of any grade
8. Has active infection requiring systemic therapy.
9. Has concurrent and active HBV and HCV infections.
10. Has HIV infection and a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or multicentric Castleman’s disease.
11. Has not recovered from major surgery or has ongoing surgical complications.
12. Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
13. Has a history of severe eye disease.
14. Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication or a previous history of inflammatory bowel disease.
15. Has uncontrolled, significant cardiovascular disease or cerebrovascular disease.
